titles.display: Battle of Ain Jalut

raw.description: 1260 battle between the Mamluk Sultanate and the Mongol Empire
raw.extract: The Battle of Ain Jalut, also spelled Ayn Jalut, was fought between the Bahri Mamluks of Egypt and the Ilkhanate on 3 September 1260 near the spring of Ain Jalut in southeastern Galilee in the Jezreel Valley. It marks the first major halt to Mongolian advances and paused their expansion into Arabia and Europe.
